## Requirements
Requirement id to satisfy + stamp: **R-2.12.1** (§8.3) — versioning, reproducibility & artifact
identity. Tier **C0/Must**. Build stage per §8.3 #9 / §9.2 C0/Stage 1 slice: `IdentityProfile idp/1`;
`address` (blob + tree rule), `identify`, `verify` sharing the canonicalizer; `VersionedRef`; both
configuration ids in the run manifest; local single-namespace name index with `publish`/`resolve`;
`supersede`/`revoke` records and edges; `InstrumentRecord`; results-row keys; golden corpus
(AC-1…-5, -12). The ticket scope also lands the schemas (land-once, CC7) for `StaleIndex`, the
sameness ladder L0–L4, reproducibility levels R0–R3, `RevocationRecord` — full enforcement/derivation
is Stage 2/3.

## Acceptance criteria
Gating (§8.3 #7 / §9.2), deterministic: **AC-R-2.12.1-{1,2,3,4,5,12}**.
- AC-1 self-describing ids parse `<algorithm>:<hex>` full length; truncated/untagged rejected at
  `verify` with `TruncatedId`/`AlgorithmMismatch`.
- AC-2 domain separation: blob, `Text` leaf and node with identical canonical bytes → three distinct ids.
- AC-3 rename stability (T-LCD-10): rename → `semantic_id` unchanged, `version_id` changed, a new
  name-history entry, `sameness = L1`; results pool by `configuration_id`.
- AC-4 pinned forms: a sealed/manifest/registry record containing a selector or display name as a
  reference fails `identify` with `UnresolvedRef`.
- AC-5 cross-implementation agreement: `address`/`identify` byte-for-byte on the golden corpus
  extended with ≥20 directory trees (symlinks, executables, empty dirs, non-ASCII names).
- AC-12 two configuration ids: seed-only difference shares `configuration_id`, differs in
  `configuration_version_id`; surface-only profile rendering shares `configuration_id`; a
  `ModelRoleTable` change alters both.

Universal phase-gate AC: verification green; every new behaviour has a fail-if-removed test; req ids
stamped in PR; unverifiable → DEFERRALS row + compensating control; ADRs for deviations/owned
decisions; BUILD_INDEX row + LEDGER advanced.

Cross-cutting invariants re-checked (esp. **CC1 anchors here** — one identity/canonicalization scheme;
**CC3 anchors here** — every sealed/executed/published form contains only pinned ids; **CC7** single
schema source; **CC8 anchors here** — additive, rename keeps `semantic_id` changes `version_id`).

## Plan
New persistent crate `crates/hh-identity` — the C0/Stage-1 idp/1 identity model as a pure-std E1
build binding (CC4). Modules: `idp` (IdentityProfile idp/1, ContentAddress, domain tags, address/
identify/verify, the canonicalizer built on `hh-wire::json`+`hh-wire::sha256` — ONE scheme, CC1);
`kinds` (RecordKind + five identity kinds, N1–N8); `refs` (VersionedRef, NameSelector, Origin);
`names` (single-namespace index, NameHistoryEntry, publish/resolve, statuses, modes); `supersede`
(supersedes reasons, RevocationRecord, StaleIndex, supersede/revoke); `sameness` (ladder L0–L4);
`repro` (levels R0–R3, InstrumentRecord); `config` (configuration_id/version_id via idp/1); `rowkeys`
(results-store + audit keys); golden corpus fixtures + pinned answers.
DF-S0.1-2 closure: `hh-embed-schema::schema_hash` computed via `hh-identity` idp/1 ContentAddress;
regenerate `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json` + `EXPECTED_SCHEMA_HASH`. Migrate `hh-ontology` config ids
to idp/1 (CC1: no second scheme). No new external deps (hermetic).
